records.text: Molot reported that Erika Kirk lacks her own office at Turning Point and works on the couch in Charlie Kirk’s office; when their son Mack sat in his father’s chair, Erika said no one had sat there since Charlie and decided only Mack could sit there. Mack’s full name remains unverified.
records.speaker: Clara Molot

appearances.snippet: The writer tells us, quote, even though she's a CEO, Erica (Erika Kirk) does not have her own office at Turning Point headquarters, opting instead to work on the couch in Charlie (Charlie Kirk)'s office near his desk, which has been preserved as a shrine. ... When I'm there, Mack (Charlie and Erika Kirk's son; full name unverified) climbs into his father's chair, eliciting a gasp from Erica (Erika Kirk). No one has sat there since Charlie (Charlie Kirk), she tells me, before deciding that only Mack (Charlie and Erika Kirk's son; full name unverified) can sit there.
